prompt: Build a village around my house.

card.name: Village Around My House

site.text: A village built around the player's existing house, which stays at the centre, on the land at this spot

style.text: Cozy medieval village look with timber, stone and plank roofs, matching a friendly home settlement

purpose.text: A home village that grows around the player's own house

avoid: Demolishing or altering the player's existing house
card.interpretation: You want a village that grows around your existing house, so the house is the centre and stays untouched. I read the site as a village on the land here, using the existing terrain, within your 64 block claim. Style is a friendly medieval look, since you gave none. Purpose is a home base. The program is a modest mix of homes, a tavern, a smithy, a barn and a chapel, with a well square as the one centrepiece.
assumptions: Medium size, about 10 buildings, with medium density
Medieval style since none was given
Home base purpose: a cozy living village
Existing terrain is used with no sculpting
Your house is the centre and is not rebuilt
Difficulty is patron, from the default setting

program.notes: Small gathering square with a well, near the player's house; paths radiate from here.
Small homes with gardens facing the paths around the player's house.
Larger two-storey homes set along the main path.
Warm common room near the green.
Open forge with anvil and grindstone, on the village side away from homes.
Barn with crop plots and animal pens.
Small chapel with bell, on a rise if one is available.
